subject: [PATCH v5 01/22] iomap: release the folio batch on iomap callback failures

reviews.author: Darrick J. Wong
reviews.summary: The reviewer found the patch reasonable and applied their Reviewed-by tag.

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch addresses a bug in the iomap folio batch mechanism, which fails to release the batch in certain error scenarios. The fix involves updating the cleanup helper to clear the flag unconditionally and release the batch when populated. This change ensures that the I/O path is properly controlled and the status of the folio batch is accurately reflected.
